content:
Tom: Quick question for Friday's LAN: can we have a "controller bank" on the mezz table? I hate playing with tangled cords.
Elena: Love this. Suggestion: label controllers with sticky initials and a little cable organizer box.
Diego: Also can we enforce a 10-min courtesy rule if someone queues up for a popular pad? 
Harper: 10-min rule seems fair for crowd games. For tournament matches we should sign up on the whiteboard.
Tom: Good call. I'll bring a bag of twist-ties and a roll of gaffer tape. :scissors:
Elena: Can we have a "sanitizer station" too? Controllers get gross after a few rounds. I'll bring wipes and some spare thumb grips.
Diego: FYI my Xbox pad has a weird drift; I'll mark it DO NOT LEND unless someone wants to fix it.
Harper: If someone brings a Switch Pro we can mirror it to the projector for Smash practice. Also suggest power strip on the mezz pillar so phones don't steal controllers' outlets.
Tom: Plan: controller bank + cable tidy + sanitizer + signup whiteboard. People who borrow should put their name on the sticky under the controller.
Elena: Also poll: do we prefer wireless only for comfort or wired only for latency? Reply with WIRELESS/WIRED/NO_PREF.
Diego: WIRED. 
Harper: NO_PREF - depends on the game.
Tom: Majority so far split. We'll keep both but label wired controllers and reserve a couple of wired ports.
mikey-bot: Event updated: "Mezz LAN - controller bank + cable tidy" Fri 19:00. RSVP: https://calendar.company/e/mezz-lan-controllers
Elena: Thanks Tom! See you all Friday :beer:
